scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build:api: npm run build:types && npm run prisma:generate -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:types && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build:types && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
